text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) 2022.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 29 Januari 2022.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai barang-barang

kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 29 Januari 2022 hingga 4 Februari 2022.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Ikan bawal putih (berat antara 200 gram hingga 400 gram seekor)

2. Udang putih (berat antara 41 ekor hingga 60 ekor sekilogram)

3. Babi hidup

4. Daging babi (perut)

5. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 19 Januari 2022

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/Jld. 13]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5

of the Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

Order 2022.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 29 January 2022.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for

the period from 29 January 2022 to 4 February 2022.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. White pomfret (weight ranges between 200 grams to 400 grams each)

2. Banana prawn (weight ranges between 41 prawns to 60 prawns per kilogram)

3. Live pig

4. Pork (belly)

5. Pork (lean and fat)

Made 19 January 2022

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/Jld. 13]

 DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Minister of Domestic Trade and Consumer Affairs
